purpose: Record what the 2024 UP MSI report makes available about the 2015 Cabugao reef-fish assessment, while keeping aggregate survey statistics separate from species-level occurrence evidence.

source.title: The West Philippine Sea: State of the Coasts — Chapter 2.2: Cabugao, Ilocos Sur
source.publication: The West Philippine Sea: State of the Coasts, pp. 109–115; University of the Philippines Marine Science Institute, 2024; UP MSI Contribution No. 1597
source.citation: Escoro, M.C.V.J.T., Recamara, D.B., Añonuevo, M.C.J., & Arceo, H.O. (2024). Cabugao, Ilocos Sur. In H. O. Arceo, M. J. P. Velos, M. A. C. Nuñez, & P. M. Aliño (Eds.), The West Philippine Sea: State of the Coasts (pp. 109–115). University of the Philippines Marine Science Institute. ISBN 978-621-8152-14-4.

studyScope.setting: Marine coral-reef fish assemblage assessment; this source adds no inland-water evidence.
studyScope.assessmentPeriod: The report labels the reef survey as 2015; exact survey dates and season were not found in the reviewed chapter.
studyScope.project: UP MSI/DOST-PCAARRD National Assessment of Coral Reef Environment (NACRE)-PEARRL project, as credited in the report figures.
studyScope.localityPrecision: The chapter maps the stations along the Sinait–Cabugao–San Juan coast and describes approximate station positions, but provides no machine-readable station coordinates or coordinate datum. Do not digitize points or boundaries from the illustrative figures.
studyScope.samplingNote: The chapter states that Pug-os and Daclapan have fewer than three replicate transects. Its reported summaries are station-level aggregates, not fish-by-transect records.

reportedFindings.aggregateSpeciesRichness: The chapter reports 134 observed reef-fish species across 33 families and subfamilies.
reportedFindings.speciesListStatus: No complete 134-name checklist, fish-by-station matrix, or specimen/voucher crosswalk was identified in the reviewed chapter. The chapter names selected target families and subfamilies, not the individual 134 species.
reportedFindings.evidenceLevel: Attributed historical reef-survey aggregate only. These figures do not identify which species occurred at each station, establish current presence or abundance, or indicate freshwater distribution, legal catchability, safety, diet, or bait suitability.

qualityAndReuseLimits: The report's reproduction note permits copying or adaptation without author permission only when the material is distributed free and credited to the authors or original source. This is conditional reuse permission, not a blanket open license; verify third-party figure and map credits before any reuse.
The 134-species total is not an accessible checklist. Do not create 134 taxa rows, station occurrence rows, a provincial inventory, or a public species page from the aggregate count.
No exact sampling dates, vouchers, fish-by-station table, machine-readable coordinates, or georeferenced geometry were found in the reviewed chapter.
Pug-os and Daclapan are marked as having fewer than three replicate transects; preserve that limitation when interpreting the reported station summaries.
The chapter reports a 2015 survey; its density and biomass estimates are historical survey values and are not current stock or catch estimates.
No figures, maps, tables, photos, raw data, or article-derived species records were copied into the repository.
nextAction: Search for the underlying 2015 NACRE-PEARRL fish checklist, transect-level records, station metadata, and dataset-specific reuse terms in public institutional repositories. If those records are not openly available, retain this as an aggregate historical source only and continue Region I freshwater coverage work.
